get_aircraft_by_address.description: Look up where one or more aircraft are right now from their ICAO 24-bit transponder addresses. An aircraft that is switched off or out of range is simply not returned.
get_aircraft_by_address.display_str_template: Get the current position of aircraft {0}.
get_aircraft_by_address.name: get_aircraft_by_address

parameters.description: One or more ICAO 24-bit addresses: six hexadecimal characters each, for example 3c675a. Every action here returns this address, so it can be chained from a search or from a flight.
parameters.name: icao24

parameters.description: Positions as they were at this moment. Leave empty for right now. OpenSky keeps live positions for one hour.
parameters.name: at_time

aircraft.description: The aircraft that were found. An aircraft that is switched off or out of range is simply absent.

callsign.description: The callsign being broadcast, e.g. 'DLH9LF'. Can be empty.

category.description: The aircraft category the transponder broadcasts, e.g. 'Large (75000 to 300000 lbs)'. Empty when it broadcasts none.

distance_km.description: Kilometres from the centre point of the search, when one was given

icao24.description: The transponder's ICAO 24-bit address in hex, for example '3c675a'. This is the aircraft's identifier across every action here.

last_contact_at.description: When any message was last heard from it (ISO 8601, UTC)

on_ground.description: Whether the aircraft is on the ground rather than flying

origin_country.description: The country the address is registered to, e.g. 'Germany'

position_source.description: How the position was received: ADS-B, ASTERIX, MLAT or FLARM

position_updated_at.description: When the position was last updated (ISO 8601, UTC)

sensors.description: Serial numbers of the receivers that heard this aircraft. Only filled in when receivers were named in the request.

spi.description: Whether the special purpose indicator is set

true_track.description: The direction of travel in degrees clockwise from north

velocity_knots.description: Speed over the ground in knots

velocity_ms.description: Speed over the ground in metres per second

vertical_rate_ft_per_min.description: Climb rate in feet per minute; negative while descending

vertical_rate_ms.description: Climb rate in metres per second; negative while descending

observed_at.description: The moment these positions describe (ISO 8601, UTC). Feed it back into 'As of' to re-read the same snapshot.

total_matched.description: How many matched before the limit was applied

get_aircraft_track.description: Get the path one aircraft flew as a list of waypoints, each with its position, altitude and heading. Leave the time empty for the track of a flight happening right now, or give a moment inside a past flight (up to 30 days back) for that flight's track.
get_aircraft_track.display_str_template: Get the track flown by aircraft {0}.
get_aircraft_track.name: get_aircraft_track

parameters.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit address: six hexadecimal characters, for example 3c675a. Every action here returns this address, so it can be chained from a search or from a flight.
parameters.name: icao24

parameters.description: Any moment between the flight taking off and landing. Leave empty for the flight happening right now. OpenSky keeps tracks for 30 days.
parameters.name: at_time

callsign.description: The callsign flown for the whole track. Can be empty.

icao24.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit address in hex

waypoint_count.description: How many waypoints the track has. Zero means OpenSky has no track for that aircraft at that moment.

time.description: When the aircraft was at this point (ISO 8601, UTC)

true_track.description: The direction of travel in degrees clockwise from north

get_arrivals_by_airport.description: List the flights that landed at an airport during a window of up to two days, with where each one came from. Arrivals are worked out overnight, so the most recent day may not be there yet.
get_arrivals_by_airport.name: get_arrivals_by_airport

parameters.description: The airport's four-letter ICAO code, for example EDDF for Frankfurt. IATA codes such as FRA are not accepted. Flights that landed here are returned.
parameters.name: airport

parameters.description: The start of the window to look in.
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: The end of the window to look in. OpenSky answers this one for windows of up to two days.
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description: The most flights to return, earliest departure first. However many were cut, the full number that matched still comes back as Total matched.
parameters.name: limit

flights.description: The flights that landed there, earliest departure first

callsign.description: The callsign flown, e.g. 'DLH9LF'. Can be empty.

departure_airport.description: ICAO code of the estimated departure airport. Empty when OpenSky could not identify one.

duration_minutes.description: How long the flight lasted, in minutes

description: Track aircraft with the OpenSky Network, a community of receivers that share live ADS-B data. Find what is flying over a place right now, look up an aircraft by its transponder address, replay the path it flew, and list the arrivals and departures at any airport.
